units.source_text: “据说艺妓要是在滑雪场上向客人打招呼，客人就会吃惊地说‘哦，是你呀！’

en.t: They say that if a geisha greets a guest on the ski slopes, the guest is startled and says, 'Oh, it's you!'

units.source_text: 因为滑雪把皮肤晒黑了，都认不出来了。

en.t: Because skiing has darkened her skin, they can no longer recognize her.

units.source_text: 而晚上又总是经过化妆的。”

en.t: And at night she is always wearing makeup.
